title: Neo4j Browser console is reachable without authentication
description: The Neo4j Browser is served without authentication on the HTTP port. The browser runs Cypher in the same session the database authenticates, and its connect form accepts arbitrary bolt endpoints.
remediation: Require authentication on the HTTP connector (or disable it), and restrict the bolt port to the application network.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Neo4j Browser console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Neo4j Browser</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
